math.model: pY = sig(b), pX|Y=1 = sig(a+w), pX|Y=0 = sig(a), pX = pY sig(a+w) + (1-pY) sig(a), p11 = pY sig(a+w)
math.chunk: X = continuous execution of the ordered chunk (1..3 relocations) from q_ref including its terminal connector to q_ref; no home return inside a chunk
math.energy: compose.py docstring: e(U,B) = min over orderings of -log max(eps, pX(order | S~_U)); F by subset DP over (U, has_multi); E(A) = F(A) - log max(eps, Y_global(A)); lambda = 0 primary, -log 0.92 = named historical control; m <= 3 single chunk = -log p11
math.admissibility: length > 3 requires >= 1 chunk of size 2-3; all-singleton partitions reported separately as diagnostics
math.selection: production NOOP gate (p_noop >= 0.5 -> NOOP); argmin E over admissible fully scored candidates plus the production K <= 3 floor (rank.b0 with the PRODUCTION scorer and rules, re-scored as one chunk -log p11 under the arm's model); ABSTAIN if none; no eta on long energies
math.interpretation: learned composition heuristic, not a calibrated joint probability

P2.question: Can (frozen or bounded scaling-trained) X rank ordered 2-3-action chunks at reached intermediate scenes on fresh families?
P2.splits: family-disjoint and fixed BEFORE any label: TRAIN_SCALE_NEW (original-TRAIN families / generator seeds), VAL_SELECT_NEW and VAL_GATE_NEW (original-VAL families / generator seeds), assigned by sha256('KGT3|split|' + family) quantiles; exposed DEV roots and lineages, every R3.1 / R3.3A / R3.1D / cohort family excluded

2d.verified_chain_stratum: clean R3COH2D generator layouts (223 layouts, 102 seed families; seeds of the 30 cohort + 5 reserve roots excluded), one layout per seed (a layout with a teacher-verified witness-search prefix first, else the lowest-K_lb layout by sha); family = seed
2d.screen: offline k3scale kill tables (MINK_TABLE_original, the generator's own construction artefact) classify ordered candidate chunks over the layout's MINK witness-set objects with parking-prior destinations into SCREEN_LIVE / SCREEN_DEAD per order; data construction only, never a planner input
2d.per_family: h0: one discordant-screen pair (both orders) + one discordant-screen triple (3 orders: the screen-live one + 2 others) + one control pair (both orders; both-live if available else both-dead); h>=1 after prefix p (teacher-verified witness-search prefix of length 1-2 when available, else the kill-table-first action of the witness set, observed in the same run): one discordant pair (both orders) + one triple (3 orders)  -> <= 12 queries
2d.ordinary_stratum: clean original-VAL / TRAIN families with a v32 X = 1 single prefix p (R3.1D design, not R3.1D families): [p | x y] both orders, [p | x y z] 2 orders, [x y] both orders at h0 (cVAE / random actions, no screen)  -> 6 queries
2d.teacher: physical2d X_CHUNKED, X only (no Y), labels.chunks_of; UNKNOWN_PLANNER / UNKNOWN_TRANSIT preserved

3d.verified_chain_stratum: clean original families (N 3-8, K_legacy any): enabler construction with the SHELF66V3 teacher's own planner (fin3d A.query, the K4/K5 generator's probe primitive): choose a non-target body B and a parking cell pB (deterministic sha order over free non-goal cells, Chebyshev >= 2 from the target); require B -> pB to plan; add ONE new ordinary obstacle E (largest generator blocker: cylinder 0.018 x 0.18) on a free cell Chebyshev-1 from B such that B -> pB no longer plans; E -> pE must plan; with E parked B -> pB must plan again; one more body Z -> pZ that plans (non-enabling relocation / prefix).  <= 3 bodies x 4 cells tried, deterministic; every A.query counts as one construction probe
3d.per_family: h0: [E B] vs [B E] (g = 2), [E B Z], [Z E B], [B E Z] (g = 3); h>=1 after Z: [Z | E B] vs [Z | B E]; control [Z E] vs [E Z]  -> 9 labelled jobs + probes
3d.ordinary_stratum: clean families with a v32 X = 1 sequence of length >= 2: fragment pair both orders at h0, and [w1 | w2 w3] both orders  -> 4 jobs
3d.teacher: physical3d X_CHUNKED on the constructed record (new obstacle in the record), X only; static starts are ideal-pose records (R3.0 HYP parity)

P2.expansion: <= 600 more per domain ONLY if, after the initial collection and BEFORE any model reads GATE: GATE support < 10 in any of (mixed h>=1 g2-3 families, discordant permutation families, mixed h0 families) -> GATE first; or training is triggered and TRAIN has < 30 discordant families or SELECT < 15 mixed families. Same rules, next families in sha order. Hard stop 1,200 queries or 20 CPU-h per domain.
P2.labels: dedup by (canonical scene, ordered chunk, contract); a completed chunk never yields anchored singleton labels; unobserved suffixes stay unobserved; UNKNOWN never negative; families are the independent unit
P2.selection_on_SELECT: a frozen model qualifies if on VAL_SELECT_NEW its h>=1 g2-3 AUROC >= 0.75 and family concordance >= 0.70 (point estimates); the simplest qualifying model is selected in the order F0, M1s, G1s; if none qualifies, bounded training

losses.O1: original observed-data NLL on REPLAY + targeted labels (marginal X for X-only labels; permutations share the endpoint Y node)
losses.O2: O1 + 0.25 x within-family mean over exact discordant permutation pairs (same start scene, endpoint, protocol) of softplus(-(logit pX(C+) - logit pX(C-))), logits clamped to [-20, 20]

training.2d: stage A: F1 (X-only modules of F0: act, pairo, mix, order_s, xy) fine-tune lr 1e-4, <= 40 epochs, patience 8; O1 and O2, seeds 0 and 1; stage B only if no stage-A run qualifies on SELECT: geometry-aware MLP X head (xrel M1, query-relative geometry) from scratch vs the original F0 X architecture from scratch, both lr 1e-3, <= 60 epochs, patience 10, with the stage-A loss that had the better SELECT concordance (O1 if tied), seeds 0 and 1
training.3d: stage A: M1 initialised from M1s_s0, lr 1e-4, <= 40 epochs, patience 8, O1 and O2, seeds 0 and 1; stage B only if no stage-A run qualifies: G1 from G1s_s0, same settings; no new architecture
training.data: REPLAY (v32 TRAIN minus DEV lineage) + R3.1 TRAIN_SCALE (3D) + TRAIN_SCALE_NEW; 32 replay roots + 32 local views per step, family-balanced; AdamW wd 1e-4, clip 10; Y frozen bitwise (asserted)
training.selection: within a stage: lower VAL_SELECT family-mean NLL, ties by SELECT concordance; across O1 / O2: O2 only if its SELECT concordance exceeds O1's (matched seed means); the selected run must also qualify on SELECT

gate.panel: VAL_GATE_NEW, opened ONCE for the single selected model of the domain (frozen or trained); F0 and the other arms are reported descriptively on the same panel
criteria: support: >= 10 independent mixed families at h>=1 with g = 2-3, >= 10 independent discordant permutation families, >= 10 mixed h0 families (g = 2 and g = 3 reported separately)
h>=1, g = 2-3 marginal pX AUROC >= 0.75 with family-cluster 95% lower bound >= 0.60
matched discordant permutation concordance (family-weighted, ties 0.5) >= 0.70 with family-cluster 95% lower bound > 0.50
trained / challenger only: paired h>=1 g2-3 AUROC gain over F0, family-cluster 95% CI lower > 0
natural K<=3 p11 AUROC drop <= 0.05 (point), Y bitwise identical, no privileged inputs; first-relocation FPR at TPR 0.8 not worse than F0 by > 0.05 (else BLOCKED)
gate.outcomes: PASS -> P3 in that domain; support short after expansion -> DATA_LIMITED (stop domain); otherwise FAIL (stop domain). One planned training recovery with a reserved untouched gate is NOT available (the gate is opened once); no singleton fallback

P3.roots: 30 certified 2D K4/K5/K6 (DEV_ORDER_2D) and 20 witnessed 3D length-4/5 (DEV_ORDER_3D); exposed development; the unordered assignment only through planners.assignment_given (ORACLE_DIAGNOSTIC)
arms: SEL-DP: selected X, grouped DP lambda 0, has_multi
F0-NEW: frozen F0 with the same objective
HIST: archived learned order (2D R3.4D FX-DP, 3D R2.4 A-DP; no rerun)
RANDOM: sha256('KGT3-P3|' + root) order + best admissible partition under the selected model
WITNESS: privileged order + best admissible partition under the selected model
P3.physical: X_CHUNKED with endpoint Y + independent replay; exact archive reuse only with identical scene, order, partition, teacher and replay semantics; quarantined outcomes never formal
P3.gate: SEL-DP >= 21/30 (2D) or >= 14/20 (3D) strict successes (UNKNOWN = not verified), >= +5 vs HIST with exact one-sided McNemar p < 0.05, positive paired gain vs RANDOM (superiority claim only if p < 0.05); WITNESS < 80 % -> protocol diagnosis; else PARTIAL (>= 50 %) or NOT_RECOVERED and no P5 in that domain

P4.arms: REC-ORDERED (primary 3A), REC-REORDER (hybrid), FLAT-INSERT (control), GA-EXACT / GA-BOUNDED (primary 3B, mode fixed per root by the declared envelope), GA-YONLY (control), B0 (production)
